dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト) - GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL based open-source Japanese medical billing system
evidence: COPY CPORCSPRTLNK.INC / CPSYSKANRI.INC / CPPTINF.INC etc - ORCA-specific copybooks
CALL ORCSJOB / ORCSDAY - ORCA subroutine naming convention
MCPAREA / MCPDATA.INC - ORCA MCP DB access pattern
COMMON-SPA copybook - ORCA shared parameter area
No EXEC CICS / EXEC SQL - uses ORCA middleware calls instead

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical clinic outpatient visit record (外来診察録/カルテ1号紙) batch print processing for JMA standard receipt software
purpose.summary: ORCBZ003 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that performs bulk printing of outpatient medical record forms (カルテ1号紙, Karte No.1 sheets). It reads patient information, insurance combination data, visit history records, and disease name records, then generates print data for outpatient charts. It supports group consultation, customized karte printing, and program options.

notable_features: 27 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPPTINF, CPHKNCOMBI, CPJYURRK, etc.)
18 CALL statements to ORCA middleware subroutines (ORCSJOB, ORCSDAY, etc.)
UNSTRING of COMMAND-PARAM for comma-delimited parameter passing
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for batch invocation
Japanese text in comments (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
MCP (Message Control Program) DB access pattern via MCPAREA/MCPDATA
SPA (Shared Parameter Area) pattern for inter-program communication
No COMP-3 usage despite being a production system
verdict.notes: Source file contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, decoded here as latin-1 causing mojibake in comments. File is truncated at 16000 chars out of 46326 bytes (1156 lines total). The ORCA system is a well-known open-source Japanese medical billing platform maintained by JMA; this is clearly production code from circa 2006-2008 based on revision history comments.
